structure.layout: app shell with fixed left sidebar nav, top bar with net-worth summary chips and account icons, single content panel holding a toolbar (add/import buttons + search) above a paginated MUI DataGrid of transactions

aesthetics.typography: Roboto throughout (MUI default): sidebar labels 16px/400, panel title 20px/700, table body 14px, header chips 12–13px; Material icons
aesthetics.typeScale: Low contrast scale: single 20px bold title, 16px nav and subtitle, 14px table body and uppercase 14px/500 buttons, 12px chip labels; bold weight used for column headers, day numbers, and amounts

notes: Dark navy MUI theme (#1f2d3d page / #253649 surfaces) with light-blue #90caf9 as the only accent (primary button, subtitle, value pills, tag chips). Rows are tall (~89px), and alternate between a darker and lighter navy. The Flow column puts small left/right arrows beside account-type icons to show money moving from one account to another (a transfer between own accounts gets a green arrow). Value is shown as an outlined pill: blue for expenses, grey/white for transfers. Description cells stack the merchant line over a category icon and label plus an entity (building icon) label. A star icon under the date marks 'Essential' items. The date is set as a bold day plus a muted month/year. The top bar has no title: just four small dark summary chips showing net-worth figures. Live verification was impossible because the live copy redirected to the login screen.
